card.name: Words meaning complement or work together
card.fires_on: The slot where 'complement', 'complementary', or a similar word (supplements, synergistic) is expected, describing two things that add to or support each other. It also fires on the misspelling 'compliment' in that sense.

modes.label: Complement-type word itself
modes.description: The word complement, complementary, or compliment used to say two things fit together or add to each other.
modes.example: their respective strengths will definitely<< compliment>> one another.

modes.label: Synergy and supplement wording
modes.description: Words like supplements or the middle of synergistic, where one treatment or drug adds to another's effect.
modes.example: hyperbaric oxygen therapy<< supplements>> traditional treatments such as surgery and antibiotics.
